entries.en: Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
entries.zh: 添加了 Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`)，现在是默认的 Fable 模型 — 1M 上下文，每个 Mtok 8 美元/40 美元，每 Mtok 缓存读取 0.20 美元

entries.en: Added `--settings <file>` to `claude remote-control`, which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart `claude remote-control`
entries.zh: 在“claude Remote-control”中添加了`--settings <file>`，它将设置文件应用于它启动的每个会话；如果文件发生更改，则在重新启动“claude Remote-control”之前不会启动新会话

entries.en: Improved the `/model` picker: "More models" is now an unnumbered row below every other, and older models open under it without renumbering the rest
entries.zh: 改进了`/model`选择器：“更多模型”现在是每行下方的未编号行，旧模型在其下打开，而无需重新编号其余模型

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's sign-in limit messages in Claude Code and on the `/device` page: they no longer name gateway settings, which the gateway's own log still names
entries.zh: 改进了克劳德代码和`/device`页面上克劳德应用程序网关的登录限制消息：它们不再命名网关设置，网关自己的日志仍然命名该设置

entries.en: Improved `claude install` and the install scripts: they finish 2 to 4 seconds sooner
entries.zh: 改进了`claude install`和安装脚本：它们更快完成 2 到 4 秒

entries.en: Improved how soon a Remote Control session whose process crashed can pick up a new message
entries.zh: 改进了进程崩溃的远程控制会话接收新消息的速度

entries.en: Improved auto mode in headless sessions, the desktop app and VS Code: reports from background subagents that wait together are answered in one model call, as in the terminal
entries.zh: 改进了无头会话、桌面应用程序和 VS Code 中的自动模式：来自一起等待的后台子代理的报告在一个模型调用中得到应答，就像在终端中一样

entries.en: Improved the agent view's row for a `claude --bg --worktree` session that couldn't set up its worktree: it now shows the error from its beginning, not an internal tag or its last 200 characters
entries.zh: 改进了无法设置其工作树的`claude --bg --worktree`会话的代理视图行：它现在从头开始显示错误，而不是内部标记或其最后 200 个字符

entries.en: Improved the messages shown when an artifact is in another organization: `/login` is offered only if it's one of yours, and Claude now says where a copy may be after an account move
entries.zh: 改进了当工件位于另一个组织中时显示的消息：仅当它是您的组织之一时才提供`/login`，并且克劳德现在会显示帐户移动后副本可能位于的位置

entries.en: Improved sessions with more images than fit in one request: Claude is told whether it has already seen a dropped image, and repeat reads of an unchanged image are limited
entries.zh: 改进了会话，图像数量超出了一次请求的容纳范围：Claude 被告知是否已经看到了已删除的图像，并且对未更改图像的重复读取受到限制

entries.en: Improved `claude remote-control`'s messages for an unanswered first-run question: each now says what to do next
entries.zh: 改进了“克劳德远程控制”针对未回答的首次运行问题的消息：现在每个消息都会说明下一步该做什么

entries.en: Improved start-up time by loading trusted TLS certificates faster
entries.zh: 通过更快地加载受信任的 TLS 证书来缩短启动时间

entries.en: Improved Claude apps gateway error messages to show the gateway's address without any user name or password
entries.zh: 改进了 Claude 应用程序网关错误消息，以显示网关地址，无需任何用户名或密码

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's spend limit error: the reset now shows in your local time, such as "resets 4pm (America/Los_Angeles)"
entries.zh: 改进了克劳德应用程序网关的支出限制错误：重置现在显示为您当地时间，例如“重置下午 4 点（美国/洛杉矶）”

entries.en: Updated the session-feedback message and the `allowedProviders` setting description to name Ultra alongside Pro and Max, and the `forceLoginMethod` description to cover every paid Claude plan
entries.zh: 更新了会话反馈消息和`allowedProviders`设置描述，将 Ultra 与 Pro 和 Max 一起命名，并更新了`forceLoginMethod`描述以涵盖每个付费 Claude 计划

entries.en: Updated the bundled dataviz skill to suggest a list of meters, one row per item, for several ratios that each have their own limit
entries.zh: 更新了捆绑的数据可视化技能，以建议一个仪表列表，每个项目一行，针对多个比率，每个比率都有自己的限制

entries.en: Updated the "Upgrade to Max" options to say "Upgrade to Max or Ultra"
entries.zh: 将“升级到 Max”选项更新为“升级到 Max 或 Ultra”

entries.en: Changed mods Claude writes to turn on without asking in auto and bypass modes, even with managed `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false` or `allowManagedDomainsOnly`, and not to load in `dontAsk` mode
entries.zh: 更改了 Claude 写入的模组，使其在自动和旁路模式下无需询问即可打开，即使使用托管`allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`或`allowManagedDomainsOnly`，也不会在`dontAsk`模式下加载

entries.en: Changed mods' own tool calls (`$.tool.call`, `$.mcp.call`) to raise no permission prompt, even under your own ask rules or in `dontAsk` and `-p` runs; deny rules and organization policy still apply
entries.zh: 更改了 mods 自己的工具调用（`$.tool.call`、`$.mcp.call`）以引发无权限提示，即使在您自己的询问规则下或在 `dontAsk` 和 `-p` 运行中也是如此；拒绝规则和组织政策仍然适用

entries.en: Changed saved Fable 5.1 model picks to move to `fable`: on Pro and Max plans at once, on Team and Enterprise plans once your organization allows it; use `/model claude-fable-5-1` to switch back
entries.zh: 更改了已保存的《神鬼寓言 5.1》模型选择，以移至“寓言”：立即使用 Pro 和 Max 计划，一旦您的组织允许，就使用 Team 和 Enterprise 计划；使用 `/model claude-`fable`-5-1` 切换回来

entries.en: Changed the fast mode labels in `/fast`, `/config` and `/model` to name your current model when it supports fast mode, and removed "(Opus only)" from the VS Code row
entries.zh: 更改了 `/fast`、`/config` 和 `/model` 中的快速模式标签，以在支持快速模式时命名当前模型，并从 VS Code 行中删除“(仅限 Opus)”

entries.en: Changed nested skill loading: `.claude/skills` folders inside `~/.claude/plugins` no longer load when Claude works on files there
entries.zh: 更改了嵌套技能加载：当克劳德处理其中的文件时，`~/.claude/plugins`内的`.claude/skills`文件夹不再加载

entries.en: Changed OpenTelemetry hook events in non-interactive sessions to leave two built-in hooks out of `num_hooks` and `num_success` after Bash and PowerShell calls
entries.zh: 更改了非交互式会话中的 OpenTelemetry 挂钩事件，以在 Bash 和 PowerShell 调用后将两个内置挂钩保留在`num_hooks`和`num_success`之外

entries.en: Changed the number of messages a Claude Desktop Code tab session can send to your other sessions before it waits for you to type again from 10 to 20
entries.zh: 将 Claude Desktop Code 选项卡会话在等待您再次键入之前可以发送到其他会话的消息数从 10 更改为 20

entries.en: Changed `AskUserQuestion` in `claude -p` and SDK sessions to deny a host's permission answer that sets the undocumented `afkTimeoutMs` input field
entries.zh: 更改了`claude -p`和 SDK 会话中的`AskUserQuestion`，以拒绝设置未记录的`afkTimeoutMs`输入字段的主机权限答案

entries.en: Changed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces`: a declared name can't be added from another source, an entry from elsewhere is hidden, and plugins the declared marketplace lists are reinstalled from it
entries.zh: 更改了托管`extraKnownMarketplaces`：无法从其他来源添加声明的名称，隐藏来自其他地方的条目，并且从其中重新安装声明的市场列表的插件

entries.en: Changed Claude in Chrome tools that an app running Claude Code provides, such as the Claude desktop app's Code tab, to follow your organization's Claude in Chrome policy
entries.zh: 更改了运行 Claude Code 的应用程序提供的 Claude in Chrome 工具（例如 Claude 桌面应用程序的“代码”选项卡），以遵循组织的 Claude in Chrome 政策

entries.en: Changed `policy_mode: layered` in the Claude apps gateway: managed MCP servers now add up over every matching policy, `match: {}` included, so a gateway already on it serves more after the upgrade
entries.zh: 更改了 Claude 应用程序网关中的“policy_mode：分层”：托管 MCP 服务器现在在每个匹配策略（包括`match: {}`）上进行累加，因此升级后其上已有的网关可以提供更多服务

entries.en: Changed headless sessions to reload mods in `.claude/skills` when their files change; set `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH=0` to turn this off
entries.zh: 更改了无头会话，以便在文件更改时重新加载`.claude/skills`中的模组；设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH=0` 将其关闭

entries.en: Changed the Cyber Verification Program sentence on a cyber safeguard block to use the same words as claude.ai
entries.zh: 更改了网络安全块上的网络验证计划句子，以使用与 claude.ai 相同的单词

entries.en: Changed Cowork cloud sessions: a PostToolUse hook can no longer replace the answer to AskUserQuestion or the plan in ExitPlanMode's result; Claude reads the originals
entries.zh: 更改了 Cowork 云会话：PostToolUse 挂钩无法再替换 AskUserQuestion 的答案或 ExitPlanMode 结果中的计划；克劳德读原著

entries.en: Changed `cp` and `mv` spelled by a path, such as `/bin/cp`, to get the same path checks as `cp` and `mv`
entries.zh: 更改了路径拼写的`cp`和`mv`，例如`/bin/cp`，以获得与`cp`和`mv`相同的路径检查

entries.en: Changed background command notifications and TaskStop results to show Claude only the start and end of a command over 1,000 characters, which saves context
entries.zh: 更改了后台命令通知和 TaskStop 结果，以仅向 Claude 显示超过 1,000 个字符的命令的开头和结尾，从而节省了上下文

entries.en: Changed artifact design guidance to treat Inter and Space Grotesk as good default typefaces
entries.zh: 更改了工件设计指南，将 Inter 和 Space Grotesk 视为良好的默认字体

entries.en: Changed the account email check to refuse only a shell command that holds your email and names a User-Agent, without asking, so other commands and scheduled runs no longer stop at its prompt
entries.zh: 更改了帐户电子邮件检查，仅拒绝保存您的电子邮件并命名用户代理的 shell 命令，无需询问，因此其他命令和计划运行不再在提示符处停止

entries.en: Changed Remote Control sessions to keep the folder they were started in: a connected client can no longer move a session to another folder
entries.zh: 更改了远程控制会话以保留它们启动的文件夹：连接的客户端无法再将会话移动到另一个文件夹

entries.en: Changed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` take-overs from an undeclared source: saved data is set aside for `cleanupPeriodDays`, and options and secrets until `claude plugin restore-set-aside`
entries.zh: 更改了未声明来源的托管`extraKnownMarketplaces`接管：保存的数据预留给`cleanupPeriodDays`，以及选项和秘密，直到“claude插件恢复设置预留”

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP OAuth 请求在服务器重定向时将刷新令牌等机密发送到另一台主机的问题

entries.en: Fixed a case where a read-only Bash command ran outside the sandbox without a permission prompt
entries.zh: 修复了只读 Bash 命令在沙箱外运行而没有权限提示的情况

entries.en: Fixed a case where Bash permission checks judged a file write from the wrong folder and didn't prompt
entries.zh: 修复 Bash 权限检查判断文件写入错误文件夹且不提示的情况

entries.en: Fixed deny rules and protected-file prompts not applying to the file that a `cp` or `mv` into a directory writes
entries.zh: 修复了拒绝规则和受保护文件提示不适用于`cp`或`mv`写入目录的文件

entries.en: Fixed the "Draws from usage credits" note showing after a switch to Fable on Enterprise seats whose plan includes Fable
entries.zh: 修复了在计划包含《神鬼寓言》的企业席位上切换到《神鬼寓言》后显示的“从使用积分中提取”注释

entries.en: Fixed the fallback model sometimes declining a request or mentioning a stopped response when the first model was blocked before replying
entries.zh: 修复了当第一个模型在回复之前被阻止时，后备模型有时会拒绝请求或提及停止响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp login` printing a SEP-2352 issuer warning each time you sign in again to a server that Claude Code registered with
entries.zh: 修复了每次再次登录 Claude Code 注册的服务器时`claude mcp login`打印 SEP-2352 颁发者警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed `NotebookEdit` deleting or overwriting a notebook's first cell when the call named no cell, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, `/net` mounts)
entries.zh: 修复了`NotebookEdit`在网络路径（UNC 共享、WSL 文件夹、`/net`挂载）上调用无单元格时删除或覆盖笔记本的第一个单元格的问题

entries.en: Fixed Edit changing the first of several matches, replacing a whole file on an empty `old_string`, or editing a notebook as text, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, `/net` mounts)
entries.zh: 修复了在网络路径（UNC 共享、WSL 文件夹、`/net` 安装）上更改多个匹配项中的第一个、替换空`old_string`上的整个文件或将笔记本编辑为文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/config` showing Manual as the default permission mode when new sessions start in auto mode; pressing Space on "Auto (default)" now saves Don't Ask, not Plan
entries.zh: 修复了当新会话以自动模式启动时`/config`显示手动作为默认权限模式的问题；在“自动（默认）”上按空格键现在可以保存“不要询问”，而不是“计划”

entries.en: Fixed `--plugin-dir .` and `--plugin-dir ./builtin` writing generated type files for Claude Code's built-in plugins into a `builtin` folder
entries.zh: 修复了 `--plugin-dir .` 和 `--plugin-dir ./builtin` 将 Claude Code 内置插件生成的类型文件写入到 `builtin` 文件夹中的问题

entries.en: Fixed context usage estimates overcounting tool definitions when exact token counts are unavailable
entries.zh: 修复了当确切的令牌计数不可用时上下文使用估计会过度计算工具定义的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/compact` showing twice in Remote Control on web and mobile
entries.zh: 修复了`/compact`在网络和移动设备上的远程控制中显示两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin auto-updates and `/plugin` marketplace updates downloading a plugin again for each worktree or folder of a repository
entries.zh: 修复了插件自动更新和`/plugin`市场更新，为存储库的每个工作树或文件夹再次下载插件

entries.en: Fixed auto mode losing a background subagent's report that had started a turn when the conversation was compacted before Claude answered it
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式丢失后台子代理的报告，该报告在克劳德回答之前压缩对话时已开始轮流

entries.en: Fixed project skills, commands and agents staying missing after their folder was removed and came back mid-session, such as with `git stash`, including after entering a worktree
entries.zh: 修复了项目技能、命令和代理在文件夹被删除并在会话中返回后仍然丢失的问题，例如使用`git stash`，包括进入工作树之后

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` sometimes telling Claude that background commands get 30 minutes when they are stopped after 10
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`有时会告诉 Claude 后台命令在 10 分钟后停止时会持续 30 分钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed `pkill`, `pgrep` and `pidwait` in cloud sessions matching the session's own parent processes
entries.zh: 修复了云会话中与会话自己的父进程匹配的`pkill`、`pgrep`和`pidwait`

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome and computer use server processes staying alive after their parent exits behind a proxy that stalls connections
entries.zh: 修复了 Chrome 中的 Claude 和计算机使用服务器进程在其父进程退出代理后仍保持活动状态的问题，该代理会停止连接

entries.en: Fixed a large hook output pointing Claude to a file that held another hook's output from the same tool call
entries.zh: 修复了一个大钩子输出，将克劳德指向一个文件，该文件保存来自同一工具调用的另一个钩子的输出

entries.en: Fixed apps that embed Claude Code getting their own PreToolUse hook's `ask` reason instead of another hook's when both asked
entries.zh: 修复了嵌入 Claude Code 的应用程序在同时询问时获取自己的 PreToolUse 挂钩的“询问”原因，而不是另一个挂钩的原因

entries.en: Fixed a PreToolUse hook's `ask` being lost when another hook's `defer` finished first and could not be honored
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个钩子的`defer`先完成且无法执行时 PreToolUse 钩子的`ask`丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rare crash on permission prompts and background tasks
entries.zh: 修复了权限提示和后台任务中罕见的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed project skills, commands and agents disappearing from the menu in SDK and desktop sessions after Claude entered a worktree
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 进入工作树后项目技能、命令和代理从 SDK 和桌面会话的菜单中消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/desktop` on macOS saying Claude Desktop is not installed when it is in `~/Applications`
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 上的`/desktop`，当 Claude Desktop 位于`~/Applications`中时，未安装该桌面

entries.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry repository attributes (`vcs.*`) missing from Claude Desktop sessions that start on a pre-started process
entries.zh: 修复了在预启动进程上启动的 Claude Desktop 会话中缺少 OpenTelemetry 存储库属性 (`vcs.*`)

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch passing "No response from model" to Claude as page content when the model reading the page returned no text; the call now fails with a clear error
entries.zh: 修复了当模型读取页面没有返回文本时，WebFetch 将“模型没有响应”作为页面内容传递给 Claude；现在调用失败并出现明显错误

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode delaying the prompt at startup when the system clock moved back while Claude Code was starting
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式在 Claude Code 启动时系统时钟向后移动时延迟启动时的提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed a command's panel sometimes not coming back after a dialog closed, leaving no panel or prompt on screen until the next redraw
entries.zh: 修复了命令面板有时在对话框关闭后不会返回的问题，直到下一次重绘之前屏幕上不会留下任何面板或提示

entries.en: Fixed a project's MCP server being disconnected after the first message in a Claude Desktop Code tab session when the desktop app has an MCP server or extension of the same name
entries.zh: 修复了当桌面应用程序具有 MCP 服务器或同名扩展时，项目的 MCP 服务器在 Claude Desktop Code 选项卡会话中出现第一条消息后断开连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed a turn ending with "API Error: EPROTO: The TLS handshake failed" when the connection broke partway through a reply; the partial reply is kept or the request is retried, as before 2.1.302
entries.zh: 修复了当连接在回复中途中断时以“API 错误：EPROTO：TLS 握手失败”结束的回合；保留部分回复或重试请求，如 2.1.302 之前

entries.en: Fixed high memory use in long sessions that repeatedly read single lines from large files
entries.zh: 修复了从大文件中重复读取单行的长会话中的高内存使用量

entries.en: Fixed fast mode losing replies, switching models or retrying for minutes when fast serving is rate-limited, overloaded or failing; it now tries standard speed on the same model first
entries.zh: 修复了快速模式在快速服务受到速率限制、过载或失败时丢失回复、切换模型或重试几分钟的问题；现在它首先在同一型号上尝试标准速度

entries.en: Fixed one request carrying far more background agent reports than intended after Claude was stopped while several were waiting
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德被阻止而几个人正在等待后，一个请求携带的后台代理报告远多于预期的问题

entries.en: Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop Code tab session to your other sessions staying paused after you typed while Claude was still working
entries.zh: 修复了在 Claude 仍在工作时键入内容后，从 Claude 桌面代码选项卡会话到其他会话的消息保持暂停状态

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` ignoring `--permission-mode`, `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, `--model`, `--effort` or `--agent` typed before `agents` when a flag such as `--verbose` was also on the line
entries.zh: 修复了当`--verbose`等标志也在线时，“claude Agents”忽略在`agents`之前键入的`--permission-mode`、`--dangerously-skip-permissions`、`--model`、`--effort`或`--agent`的问题

entries.en: Fixed a case where Remote Control showed as off with "login expired" in the desktop app while its connection was still up, because the app was briefly unable to hand over a sign-in token
entries.zh: 修复了以下情况：远程控制在桌面应用程序中显示为“登录已过期”，但其连接仍处于连接状态，因为该应用程序暂时无法移交登录令牌

entries.en: Fixed a Remote Control message sent with "Queue for later" reaching Claude in the middle of the running turn
entries.zh: 修复了在运行回合中途到达克劳德时发送的“稍后排队”的远程控制消息

entries.en: Fixed the git status given to Claude at session start reading as clean when git status failed; it now reads as unavailable
entries.zh: 修复了当 git status 失败时，在会话开始时给予 Claude 的 git status 读取为干净的问题；现在显示为不可用

entries.en: Fixed the git status given to Claude at session start showing the first listed file as staged when its changes were not staged
entries.zh: 修复了会话开始时给予 Claude 的 git 状态，显示第一个列出的文件已暂存，但其更改未暂存

entries.en: Fixed a hang or out-of-memory crash when a connector in a cloud session lists resources with very long names
entries.zh: 修复了云会话中的连接器列出名称很长的资源时出现的挂起或内存不足崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control showing as connected after its connection closed for good while the session's history was still uploading
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制在连接永久关闭但会话历史记录仍在上传后显示为已连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode turning off when you return to a conversation from agent view
entries.zh: 修复了当您从代理视图返回对话时屏幕阅读器模式关闭的问题

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode y/n questions taking as yes a stray "y" at the end of text typed as the question opened
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式 y/n 问题，将问题打开时键入的文本末尾的杂散“y”视为是

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that a host is probably not allowed when it is allowed and the network proxy could not connect to it
entries.zh: 修复了云会话告诉 Claude 主机在允许且网络代理无法连接到该主机时可能不被允许的问题

entries.en: Fixed an MCP server sometimes showing as connected with no tools after it was reconnected or the session's directory changed while its tools were still loading
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 服务器在重新连接后有时显示为未使用任何工具进行连接或会话目录在其工具仍在加载时发生更改的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash commands sometimes running in the wrong folder when Claude sent several at once and an earlier one changed folders
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude 一次发送多个命令且较早的命令更改了文件夹时，Bash 命令有时会在错误的文件夹中运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed files Claude sends from cloud and Remote Control sessions failing at once when an upload gets an HTTP 507 from a proxy; the upload now gets a second try
entries.zh: 修复了当上传从代理获取 HTTP 507 时，Claude 从云和远程控制会话发送的文件立即失败的问题；现在可以再次尝试上传

entries.en: Fixed new messages not being saved, and `claude -p`, SDK and VS Code sessions hanging, when memory ran out while the transcript was being read
entries.zh: 修复了读取记录时内存耗尽时未保存新消息以及`claude -p`、SDK 和 VS Code 会话挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed sign-in, token refresh and logout waiting indefinitely when something on the network accepts the connection but never answers the TLS handshake
entries.zh: 修复了当网络上的某些内容接受连接但从不应答 TLS 握手时，登录、令牌刷新和注销无限期等待的问题

entries.en: Fixed a sent file showing under a different name in the Claude apps when its name hid text-direction or control characters; Claude now refuses to send such a file
entries.zh: 修复了当名称隐藏文本方向或控制字符时，已发送的文件在克劳德应用程序中显示为不同名称的问题；克劳德现在拒绝发送这样的文件

entries.en: Fixed sub-agent progress summaries running a request to its end after the model replied with a tool call
entries.zh: 修复了模型通过工具调用回复后运行请求结束的子代理进度摘要

entries.en: Fixed Bash reads such as `grep -r foo "$PWD/src"` asking for permission when the same command with the path typed out runs without asking
entries.zh: 修复了当带有输入路径的相同命令在不询问的情况下运行时请求许可的 Bash 读取，例如“grep -r foo“$PWD/src””

entries.en: Fixed Claude apps gateway refusing to start when a `desktop` setting holds a field newer than the gateway, such as a managed MCP server's `oauth.omitResource`; it now warns and serves it
entries.zh: 修复了当“桌面”设置包含比网关更新的字段（例如托管 MCP 服务器的`oauth.omitResource`）时，克劳德应用程序网关拒绝启动的问题；现在它会发出警告并为其提供服务

entries.en: Fixed Bash commands coming back empty for zsh users whose `.zshrc` sets `KSH_OPTION_PRINT`
entries.zh: 修复了`.zshrc`设置`KSH_OPTION_PRINT`的 zsh 用户的 Bash 命令返回为空的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent view erasing another agent view's saved input text when it restarted for an update with nothing typed
entries.zh: 修复了代理视图在重新启动以进行更新但未键入任何内容时会删除另一个代理视图已保存的输入文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed remote sessions giving no reply after a restart when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocked a replayed permission answer; these hooks no longer run on that replay
entries.zh: 修复了当`UserPromptSubmit`挂钩阻止重播权限答案时，远程会话在重新启动后没有回复的问题；这些钩子不再在该重播中运行

entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control` accepting a `y` typed without Enter at its first-run question when the terminal's input ended
entries.zh: 修复了当终端输入结束时，“claude Remote-control”在首次运行问题时接受不输入 Enter 的`y`的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Desktop not showing spend limit warnings behind a Claude apps gateway whose policy has no `code:` rules
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude Desktop 在策略没有“代码：”规则的 Claude 应用程序网关后面不显示支出限制警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen sessions with some plugins ending with an error when a tool result that had got shorter scrolled off the top of the screen
entries.zh: 修复了某些插件的全屏会话，当工具结果变短滚动到屏幕顶部时，会出现错误

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestions making extra API requests when the model replied with a tool call
entries.zh: 修复了当模型通过工具调用回复时发出额外 API 请求的提示建议

entries.en: Fixed `PreToolUse` `mcp_tool` hooks on stdio and HTTP MCP servers being skipped when their answer was over 16 MiB; the tool call is now refused
entries.zh: 修复了 stdio 和 HTTP MCP 服务器上的`PreToolUse``mcp_tool`挂钩在其答案超过 16 MiB 时被跳过的问题；工具调用现在被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed skill and command names holding a Bamum letter that some fonts draw as blank: they are now refused
entries.zh: 修复了带有 Bamum 字母且某些字体绘制为空白的技能和命令名称：它们现在被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` on Linux exiting 0 in silence when a full NFS export or a used-up NFS quota lost transcript lines: it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1
entries.zh: 修复了当完整 NFS 导出或用完的 NFS 配额丢失转录行时，Linux 上的`claude -p`默默退出 0：它现在打印错误，并在文本和 json 输出中退出 1

entries.en: Fixed background agents being reported as stopped by the user, and refused a resume, when a service interrupted a cloud session and nobody pressed Stop
entries.zh: 修复了当服务中断云会话并且没有人按下“停止”时，后台代理被报告为被用户停止并拒绝恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed NotebookEdit reporting success to hooks and telemetry when the edit failed, for example when the notebook changed while the permission prompt was open
entries.zh: 修复了编辑失败时 NotebookEdit 向挂钩和遥测报告成功的问题，例如，当权限提示打开时笔记本发生更改时

entries.en: Fixed a blank screen or no answer at startup, and empty `claude mcp list` output, when a stored MCP sign-in record was null
entries.zh: 修复了当存储的 MCP 登录记录为空时，启动时出现空白屏幕或无应答以及空`claude mcp list`输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Artifact tool telling Claude to add filters when an artifact's database collection is too large to sort; it now says to read the collection page by page and sort the results
entries.zh: 修复了 Artifact 工具，当工件的数据库集合太大而无法排序时，告诉 Claude 添加过滤器；现在它说逐页读取集合并对结果进行排序

entries.en: Fixed a restarted cloud session dropping a message with a large image when the restart came before Claude's first reply to it
entries.zh: 修复了在克劳德首次回复之前重新启动的云会话会丢弃带有大图像的消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed a restarted cloud session leaving a subagent's message to the main conversation unanswered
entries.zh: 修复了重新启动的云会话导致子代理发送给主对话的消息未得到答复的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told when you stop or pause a running workflow, so it no longer says the workflow is still running
entries.zh: 修复了当您停止或暂停正在运行的工作流程时克劳德没有被告知的问题，因此它不再表示工作流程仍在运行

entries.en: Windows: Fixed `FileChanged` hooks stopping for paths set through `watchPaths` after the first shell command, when the session's working directory had a lowercase drive letter
entries.zh: Windows：修复了当会话的工作目录具有小写驱动器号时，在第一个 shell 命令之后通过`watchPaths`设置的路径，`FileChanged`挂钩会停止

entries.en: macOS: Fixed "Unable to read managed policy settings" at startup when a valid MDM profile was slow to read: the read is retried once, and a timeout is now reported as a timeout
entries.zh: macOS：修复了启动时有效 MDM 配置文件读取速度缓慢时“无法读取托管策略设置”的问题：重试一次读取，现在将超时报告为超时

entries.en: Gateway: Improved spend limits on a busy replica, which now skips fewer checks and records spend sooner
entries.zh: 网关：改进了繁忙副本的支出限制，现在可以跳过更少的检查并更快地记录支出

entries.en: Windows: Improved startup and first-command time by finding programs on PATH without starting a helper process
entries.zh: Windows：通过在 PATH 上查找程序而无需启动帮助程序进程，从而改进了启动和首次命令时间

entries.en: Windows: Improved startup time with a standard Git for Windows install by no longer checking which git.exe to run on every launch
entries.zh: Windows：通过不再检查每次启动时运行哪个 git.exe，使用适用于 Windows 安装的标准 Git 改进了启动时间

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed an on-demand runner that the server refuses because it is not needed (session ended or paused, work order superseded) to exit 0 instead of 1
entries.zh: 自托管运行程序：更改了服务器拒绝的按需运行程序，因为不需要它（会话结束或暂停，工作订单被取代）以退出 0 而不是 1

entries.en: Windows: Changed how Claude Code finds programs it starts itself, such as git, to skip relative and UNC PATH entries and links onto a network share, and to pick up PATH changes from settings
entries.zh: Windows：更改了 Claude Code 查找自身启动的程序（例如 git）的方式，以跳过相对路径和 UNC 路径条目以及网络共享的链接，并从设置中获取路径更改

entries.en: Gateway: Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry upstreams to ignore the `ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL` variables in the gateway's environment. Set `base_url` on the upstream to use another endpoint
entries.zh: 网关：更改了 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上游，以忽略网关环境中的`ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL`变量。在上游设置 `base_url` 以使用另一个端点

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a warning above the prompt box when both an auth token and an API key are set, matching the terminal's startup warning
entries.zh: [VSCode] 在设置 auth token 和 API key 时在提示框上方添加警告，与终端的启动警告相匹配

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a plugin's permission request showing a name with hidden characters: it now reads "a plugin"
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了插件的权限请求显示带有隐藏字符的名称：现在显示为“插件”
